CVE-2026-103433.title: Docker Buildx Bake does not request the expected fs.read approval ...
CVE-2026-103433.description: Docker Buildx Bake does not request the expected fs.read approval for certain filesystem inputs. An untrusted Bake definition can expose a readable file through a pathless secret whose ID is interpreted as a client-side pathname, or consume a local OCI image layout outside the project after entitlement validation checks a different path representation. Users who run untrusted Bake definitions are affected.

CVE-2026-121541.title: In Docker Buildx versions v0.19.0 through v0.38.0, an untrusted B ...
CVE-2026-121541.description: In Docker Buildx versions v0.19.0 through v0.38.0, an untrusted Bake definition that builds multiple targets together may expose files accessible to the Buildx client without the expected fs.read approval. Under certain conditions, filesystem paths from some targets are not verified against the approved entitlements. Users who run untrusted Bake definitions may be affected. The issue is fixed in v0.38.1.

CVE-2026-121542.title: In Docker Buildx versions v0.19.0 through v0.38.0, an untrusted B ...
CVE-2026-121542.description: In Docker Buildx versions v0.19.0 through v0.38.0, an untrusted Bake definition may expose files accessible to the Buildx client without the expected fs.read approval. Under certain conditions, paths under the same parent directory as the current working directory whose names use the working directory's basename as a prefix can skip the filesystem entitlement check. Exploitation requires specific matching filenames next to the current project directory. Users who run untrusted Bake definitions may be affected. The issue is fixed in v0.38.1.

CVE-2026-93325.title: Buildx bake requires the user to grant entitlements with --allow  ...
CVE-2026-93325.description: Buildx bake requires the user to grant entitlements with --allow or an interactive prompt before a build reaches outside the working directory. Under --progress=rawjson that consent step is skipped.
